We’re back in Guatemala (a balmy 70 degrees!) this weekend for YCS – Guatemala at the Conquistador Hotel! Who will become the new YCS Guatemala Champion?221 Duelists from all across the Americas are ready to Duel! In addition to the Guatemalans, 55 Duelists from El Salvador, 17 from Mexico, 11 from Honduras, 3 from the US, 1 from Nicaragua and 1 from Panama are here to vy for the title YCS Champion!
